about_short_description.short_description: Wolfia helps modern companies accelerate security reviews, helping close deals faster using generative AI.

product.name: Wolfia AI Agent
product.description: An AI-powered assistant that learns from a company's internal knowledge to provide instant, expert-level answers to sales and security questions, automating repetitive tasks like questionnaires and RFP responses.

product.name: Security Questionnaire Automation
product.description: A service that automates the completion of security questionnaires by extracting and applying verified company knowledge to answer repetitive security review questions rapidly and consistently.

product.name: RFP Response Automation
product.description: A tool that automatically drafts detailed responses to Request for Proposals (RFPs) by leveraging a company's existing knowledge base, improving response speed and consistency.

product.name: Wolfia AI Trust Center
product.description: A platform that consolidates and presents a company's AI security and compliance documentation transparently to enterprise buyers, facilitating faster security reviews and deal closures.
